$comment: Exposure-based advisory backlog (audit D-05). Every entry was reviewed as NOT reachable from the deployed runtime; scripts/sca-check.mjs fails CI on any advisory not listed here, so a new advisory - or one on a runtime package - must be fixed or reviewed before it can merge.

@babel/core.reason: Next.js/webpack build toolchain (webpack, terser -> serialize-javascript, babel, browserslist, postcss-selector-parser). Build-time only, over repository-controlled source.

@babel/helpers.reason: Next.js/webpack build toolchain (webpack, terser -> serialize-javascript, babel, browserslist, postcss-selector-parser). Build-time only, over repository-controlled source.

@remix-run/node.reason: Pulled in only by @tanstack/react-form for its Remix adapter (@tanstack/react-form/remix). The app imports the core entry point only, so none of it is bundled or executed.

@remix-run/router.reason: Pulled in only by @tanstack/react-form for its Remix adapter (@tanstack/react-form/remix). The app imports the core entry point only, so none of it is bundled or executed.

@remix-run/server-runtime.reason: Pulled in only by @tanstack/react-form for its Remix adapter (@tanstack/react-form/remix). The app imports the core entry point only, so none of it is bundled or executed.

@vitest/mocker.reason: Test runner (vitest/vite/@vitest/mocker). Runs only under `bun run test` locally and in CI.

ajv.reason: react-email dev preview server (@v1/email devDependency: socket.io/engine.io/ws, conf -> ajv -> fast-uri). A local preview tool; never deployed or started in production.
